summary: 3-layer immersive mode defense system verified via static code analysis. All 8 features implemented correctly. Backend API healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: Broadcast action string matches exactly: 'expo.modules.emideviceadmin.REAPPLY_IMMERSIVE' in both service and module
API 30+ uses WindowInsetsController with BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE (auto-hides bars after swipe)
Pre-API 30 uses OnSystemUiVisibilityChangeListener for instant re-hide
RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED flag correctly used for Android 13+ (TIRAMISU) broadcast registration

success_rate.frontend: N/A - React Native (Expo) mobile app; 8/8 immersive mode features verified via static analysis

context_for_next_testing_agent: 3-layer immersive mode defense implemented. React Native (Expo) app — NOT a web app. Backend APIs healthy at https://device-lock-test.preview.emergentagent.com.

reEnforceImmersiveMode_in_refresh_loop.implementation: Called every 1s via REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS, sends REAPPLY_IMMERSIVE broadcast

blocker_overflow_px_expansion.implementation: BLOCKER_OVERFLOW_PX=20 added to both top (statusBar+20) and bottom (navBar+20) blocker heights

flag_watch_outside_touch.implementation: FLAG_WATCH_OUTSIDE_TOUCH added to both topParams and bottomParams flags

installImmersiveGuards_registers_receive.implementation: BroadcastReceiver registered with IntentFilter(ACTION_REAPPLY_IMMERSIVE), RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED for API 33+

receiver_callback_reapplies_immersive.implementation: onReceive() calls applyImmersiveMode(currentAct) on UI thread

installImmersiveGuards_sets_listener.implementation: OnSystemUiVisibilityChangeListener installed for pre-API 30, re-hides bars with 100ms delay when fullscreen flag drops

api30_behavior_alternative.implementation: API 30+ uses BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE which auto-hides bars after swipe gesture

enableImmersiveMode_wiring.implementation: Calls applyImmersiveMode() + installImmersiveGuards() on UI thread

disableImmersiveMode_cleanup.implementation: Shows bars via WindowInsetsController/systemUiVisibility, then calls uninstallImmersiveGuards()

uninstallImmersiveGuards_cleanup.implementation: Unregisters broadcast receiver and removes visibility listener

pre_api30.implementation: systemUiVisibility = IMMERSIVE_STICKY | FULLSCREEN | HIDE_NAVIGATION | LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN | LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION | LAYOUT_STABLE
